name: Dataset-Supplied Sub-Layout Renderer
description: Renders a JSON layout that a dataset field itself contains, rather than a layout written statically in this file. The field's content is produced server-side by a filldataset call earlier in the page (e.g. wheninit/whenload) — typically a *_V2-suffixed proc that returns a ready-to-render layout fragment (its own settingsView field) alongside the data it describes. Distinct from atom.hide-conditional / composition-by-JSON-authoring: this is composition by server-returned JSON at runtime.
sourceRefs: examples/purchase-order-fapo-fapi.md (_fapi-general-sect: dsCountryMasterDeliverTo.settingsView, populated by PWA.CountryMasterView_V2 in _fapi-whenload-events)

includerefdata.description: Seen true on the only usage found.

contenttype.description: Seen "json" — tells the engine to parse the bound field as a layout tree rather than render it as text.

binding.description: Seen true — marks content as a live dataset binding expression rather than a literal layout.

content.description: Binding expression pointing at the dataset field holding the sub-layout JSON, e.g. "[dsCountryMasterDeliverTo.settingsView]".

usageNote: The producing filldataset call's dset/args (layout_docno, doctype, subViewDset, dataset) determine what shape the returned sub-layout takes; treat the pair (filldataset call + view atom) as one unit when reusing this pattern, not the view atom alone.
